words.gloss_range: perfect 3mp speech verb introducing a completed collective utterance
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speaking, reporting, and voicing; locally the public speech-act that launches the brothers' reproach

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the oath formula opened by the reported speech
the accusation and terminal prediction contained inside the quote

words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) makes the brothers enter as a plural voice before any named subject appears. The perfect verb frames their rebuke as a completed speech-act, while the following oath and terminal prediction remain inside one quoted unit. Across the scene boundary, Jacob's solitary grief-speech is met by collective judgment, and the same brothers' oath formula recurs in the surah at charged moments (12:73, 12:91, 12:95). The long reported-speech opening also drops straight into the clipped ta-oath onset, so the voice turns quickly from narration into pressure.

topics.headline: plural voice enters abruptly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers arrive first as a collective grammatical voice, not as named individuals.
topics.reason: The 3mp perfect ending supplies the recoverable subject, and the attachment evidence identifies the plural speakers as the sons replying to Jacob.

topics.headline: one quoted accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the oath, persistence claim, memory object, and two endpoints as one performed rebuke.
topics.reason: Attachment analysis makes words 2-13 the quoted complement of {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}), so the whole utterance is governed by the speech verb.

topics.headline: surah oath voice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this rebuke as another brotherly oath-turn in Surah 12, while the social direction shifts from Jacob's solitary grief to the sons' plural verdict.
topics.reason: The current opening matches the brothers' oath formula elsewhere in Surah 12 (12:73, 12:91, 12:95) and follows Jacob's singular speech in 12:83-84.

topics.headline: launch into pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reported-speech opening move immediately into the clipped oath onset.
topics.reason: The sound observation is anchored in the adjacent surface sequence {{ar:قَالُوا۟ تَ}} ({{tr:qālū ta}}).

words.gloss_range: oath particle, locally fused into the divine-name oath formula and licensing the elided-negative answer

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed sworn-by name
the oath answer whose negation is implied
the following remembrance verb bound into the same sound chain

words.prose: {{ar:تَ}} ({{tr:ta}}) is not a loose preposition; it is the restricted oath particle that governs {{ar:اللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) and throws its force onto the following imperfect. The broader bi-llāhi variant confirms the oath function, but the local ta-form keeps the more specialized register. Because the negator is not written before {{ar:تَفْتَأُ}} ({{tr:taftaʾu}}), the particle helps carry the idiom "you do not cease" inside a compressed oath answer. Its initial sound also starts the local {{ar:تَ}} ({{tr:ta}}), {{ar:تَفْتَأُ}} ({{tr:taftaʾu}}), {{ar:تَذْكُرُ}} ({{tr:tadhkuru}}) pressure chain.

topics.headline: oath carries hidden negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the oath particle helps make a formally positive imperfect mean ceaseless persistence.
topics.reason: The bundle explicitly marks formulaic oath-verb ellipsis and implied negation in the oath frame.

topics.headline: restricted oath register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chosen particle gives the rebuke a specialized oath register, while the broader variant only confirms the oath function.
topics.reason: The local surface is {{ar:تَ}} ({{tr:ta}}), so the broader {{ar:بِاللَّهِ}} ({{tr:bi-llāhi}}) evidence is useful as register contrast, not as the governing local reading.

topics.headline: triple onset pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears oath, persistence, and remembrance bound by repeated initial {{ar:تَ}} ({{tr:ta}})-sound.
topics.reason: The adjacent words visibly repeat the same onset and the particle is graphically tied to the following divine name in the formula.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name governed as the sworn-by object in the oath formula
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship, awe, and the proper divine name; locally the unique proper name invoked in oath, not a common noun for a deity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the oath particle governing the genitive name

words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) supplies the sworn-by name, genitive under {{ar:تَ}} ({{tr:ta}}), so the divine name is structurally part of the oath and not the subject of the sentence. The proper-name form fixes a unique referent rather than a generic deity term. Derivational pressures of worship, awe, or bewilderment may color the solemnity of the formula, but the local function is the proper divine name authorizing the brothers' rebuke; that purpose contrasts with Yusuf's refuge formula in 12:23 and 12:79.

topics.headline: genitive oath object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name is the grammatical object of the oath, not a decorative invocation.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment both mark the name as genitive governed by the oath particle.

topics.headline: unique divine referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the rebuke leaning on the unique proper divine name rather than an indefinite divine category.
topics.reason: The local form is tagged as a proper noun and the supplied lexical evidence distinguishes the proper name from common-noun deity language.

topics.headline: awe coloring, not alternate parse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the formula's solemn weight and its contrast with Yusuf's divine-refuge invocations, without replacing the proper-name parse.
topics.reason: Derivational disputes can supply semantic pressure, but the local word remains the proper name in an oath formula.

topics.headline: brothers' oath refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this invocation belongs to a recurring oath register in the Yusuf narrative (12:73, 12:85, 12:91, 12:95).
topics.reason: The row family gives concrete Surah 12 oath references, and the current formula matches that oath frame.

words.gloss_range: 2ms imperfect cessation verb made negative by the oath frame: you do not cease
words.root_gloss_range: ceasing or leaving off; locally continuation is produced by negating the cessation verb within the oath idiom

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the complement action that Jacob does not cease
the oath frame that supplies the implied negation

words.prose: {{ar:تَفْتَأُ}} ({{tr:taftaʾu}}) is the ayah's paradoxical persistence verb: the lexeme points to ceasing, but the oath frame supplies the missing negator, so Jacob is accused of not ceasing. The following {{ar:تَذْكُرُ}} ({{tr:tadhkuru}}) is its complement, making the remembered act the content of the persistence rather than a separate event. Its hapax status and hamza catch make this diagnosis unusually marked, and the later command to go and seek in 12:87 answers the brothers' picture of grief as stasis with movement.

topics.headline: stopping becomes not-stopping
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that persistence is created by a cessation word under hidden negation.
topics.reason: The oath construction supplies elided negation, and the lexical row family identifies the root as a cessation verb.

topics.headline: remembering fills persistence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Jacob's ceaselessness defined specifically as remembering Yusuf, not as generic emotional intensity.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:تَذْكُرُ}} ({{tr:tadhkuru}}) as the complement predicate of {{ar:تَفْتَأُ}} ({{tr:taftaʾu}}).

topics.headline: singular arrested verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers' diagnosis uses a one-time Quranic root whose sound contains a stop inside a claim of not stopping.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as hapax, and the form contains the hamza noted by the sound rows.

topics.headline: stasis before seeking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the narrative contrast between the brothers' accusation of stuck grief here and Jacob's later command to move and seek in 12:87.
topics.reason: The explicit inter-ayah contrast is coherent and does not override the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: 2ms imperfect complement: remembering or mentioning Yusuf as the ongoing action
words.root_gloss_range: remembering, mentioning, reminding, recollecting, and invoking; locally direct Form I recall or mention with Yusuf as explicit object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the direct object of the remembrance
the non-cessation verb completed by the remembrance

words.prose: {{ar:تَذْكُرُ}} ({{tr:tadhkuru}}) supplies the content of Jacob's not-ceasing: the ongoing act is remembering or mentioning {{ar:يُوسُفَ}} ({{tr:yūsufa}}). Its Form I surface keeps the memory direct and continuous, not the delayed recovery of memory seen in 12:45 or a reflective Form V pattern. Because it stands immediately before the endpoint particle, the brothers make remembering itself the action that runs toward ruin or perishing. Surah 12 turns memory into a thread: Yusuf asks to be remembered in 12:42, memory returns in 12:45, and here the father is accused of unbroken remembrance.

topics.headline: remembering names its object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob's ceaselessness is not abstract grief but an object-directed act centered on Yusuf.
topics.reason: {{ar:تَذْكُرُ}} ({{tr:tadhkuru}}) is the complement of {{ar:تَفْتَأُ}} ({{tr:taftaʾu}}) and governs {{ar:يُوسُفَ}} ({{tr:yūsufa}}) as direct object.

topics.headline: plain recall, not all remembrance forms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers use direct Form I recall or mention, while other surah memory forms mark delayed or reflective recollection.
topics.reason: The broader root includes several derivational patterns, but the local surface is Form I and is transitive with a named object.

topics.headline: memory motif turns accusatory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same root move from requested and recovered memory to an accusation against Jacob's unstoppable memory.
topics.reason: The cited Surah 12 references provide concrete same-root scenes (12:42, 12:45, 12:96) without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: memory drives terminal clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers make remembrance itself the action leading toward ruin or perishing.
topics.reason: {{ar:تَذْكُرُ}} ({{tr:tadhkuru}}) immediately precedes {{ar:حَتَّى}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}), whose endpoint scope covers the two terminal clauses.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper noun in accusative, the explicit object of remembering

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the transitive memory verb governing the name
the endpoint particle following the completed memory phrase

words.prose: {{ar:يُوسُفَ}} ({{tr:yūsufa}}) is the explicit accusative object of {{ar:تَذْكُرُ}} ({{tr:tadhkuru}}), so the brothers do not leave Jacob's memory vague: it is fixed on the known son. The proper foreign name is definite by name-status and specially declined as a diptote, but that morphology serves the local object role rather than an etymological reading. The same name crosses from lament in 12:84 into accusation here, then the endpoint marker follows immediately.

topics.headline: Yusuf fixed as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob's ceaseless memory is tied to the named son, not to grief in general.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:يُوسُفَ}} ({{tr:yūsufa}}) as the direct object of {{ar:تَذْكُرُ}} ({{tr:tadhkuru}}).

topics.headline: foreign name morphology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the name's special Arabic morphology while keeping the local sense as simple proper-name reference.
topics.reason: QAC tags the word as a foreign proper noun; that supports diptote morphology but not an etymological interpretation in context.

topics.headline: same name, shifted function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the unchanged name move from Jacob's lament in 12:84 into the brothers' accusation in 12:85.
topics.reason: The same proper name is referentially continuous across the scene boundary; the 40:34 contrast remains an external echo, not a local parse.

topics.headline: memory phrase closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the named memory phrase close just before the sentence turns to terminal outcomes.
topics.reason: The name is the last word before {{ar:حَتَّى}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}), the threshold into the endpoint clauses.

words.prose: {{ar:حَتَّى}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) turns the accusation from a present habit into a projected endpoint. It scopes over both branches, {{ar:تَكُونَ حَرَضًا}} ({{tr:takūna ḥaraḍan}}) and {{ar:أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْهَالِكِينَ}} ({{tr:aw takūna mina al-hālikīn}}), so the two outcomes are not detached statements. The subjunctive force keeps the ruin and perishing as anticipated consequences in the brothers' speech rather than completed facts. Its doubled ta makes the threshold audibly weighty as the sentence crosses from ongoing memory into terminal prediction.

topics.headline: one endpoint over two branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle governs a two-branch terminal architecture, not just the first clause.
topics.reason: Attachment and translation support mark both terminal alternatives as under the same {{ar:حَتَّى}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) scope.

topics.headline: anticipated endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the brothers forecasting what the memory will reach, not reporting that Jacob has already reached it.
topics.reason: The following imperfects are marked subjunctive after the particle and introduce projected endpoint/result clauses.

topics.headline: audible threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a weighted threshold between ongoing remembrance and terminal prediction.
topics.reason: The invariant particle stands immediately before the governed subjunctive and carries geminated sound weight in recitation.

words.gloss_range: 2ms subjunctive imperfect of being or becoming, locally projected becoming into the first ruin-state
words.root_gloss_range: being, existing, becoming, and coming to be; locally selected as projected becoming under the endpoint particle

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the particle governing the projected clause

words.prose: The first {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}) is governed by {{ar:حَتَّى}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}), so it projects a possible endpoint rather than stating a present fact. With {{ar:حَرَضًا}} ({{tr:ḥaraḍan}}) as predicate, the being verb leans toward becoming: Jacob is imagined as entering a ruin-state. This first clause sets the audible and syntactic pattern for the later repeated {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}) branch. The accepted {{ar:يَكُونَ}} ({{tr:yakūna}}) variant would shift the discourse stance from direct address to third-person prognosis, but it does not change the first endpoint itself.

topics.headline: subjunctive first endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first endpoint as projected becoming, not already-real ruin.
topics.reason: The verb follows {{ar:حَتَّى}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) and QAC marks the 2ms subjunctive form.

topics.headline: being into ruin-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ruin framed as a state Jacob may become, not merely an illness he may have.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:حَرَضًا}} ({{tr:ḥaraḍan}}) as predicate of this first {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}).

topics.headline: direct address versus prognosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a one-prefix variant changes whether Jacob is addressed directly or described from outside, while the predicted ruin remains the same.
topics.reason: The local surface keeps 2ms address; the accepted variant is retained as discourse contrast rather than replacing the local morphology.

topics.headline: first half of paired becoming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this first becoming clause sets the pattern for the later repeated {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}) branch.
topics.reason: The two identical verbs form a local bicolon, and same-surah k-w-n parallels such as 12:33 are contrastive rather than determinative.

words.prose: {{ar:حَرَضًا}} ({{tr:ḥaraḍan}}) names the first terminal outcome as a state of bodily wasting or ruin. Its accusative role is tied to {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}), and its indefiniteness makes Jacob a case of ruin rather than the bearer of a familiar labeled illness. The root's other Quranic side urges others into action (4:84, 8:65), but this rare nominal form is the exhausted result-state; paired with {{ar:الْهَالِكِينَ}} ({{tr:al-hālikīn}}), it becomes the pre-death half of an escalating terminal pair. Its heavy ḥāʾ and ḍād texture lets the first doom term already sound depleted before the final perishing class lands.

topics.headline: indefinite ruin predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob is projected as becoming a ruin-state, not merely suffering a symptom.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite accusative predicate under the first {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}).

topics.headline: terminal depletion image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the brothers' prognosis as bodily depletion near collapse, stronger than generic sickness.
topics.reason: The lexical rows identify the local nominal sense as wasting or consumed ruin, and no guardrail evidence contradicts that sense.

topics.headline: incitement reversed into exhaustion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root family can drive action elsewhere, while here the nominal form names spent ruin.
topics.reason: The Form II incitement parallels (4:84, 8:65) and vowel variants are valid contrasts, but the local surface remains the singular nominal ruin-state.

topics.headline: first doom term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices {{ar:حَرَضًا}} ({{tr:ḥaraḍan}}) as the first heavy term in an ordered movement from depletion to perishing.
topics.reason: The word closes the first branch and is explicitly paired with the final perishing-class term in the terminal bicolon.

words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) prevents the two endpoints from collapsing into one stacked description. It coordinates {{ar:تَكُونَ حَرَضًا}} ({{tr:takūna ḥaraḍan}}) with {{ar:تَكُونَ مِنَ الْهَالِكِينَ}} ({{tr:takūna mina al-hālikīn}}) as alternatives: either outcome would satisfy the brothers' projected limit. At the same time, the meanings are ordered, so the second branch feels heavier, moving from bodily ruin to membership among the perishing. The short particle creates a quick audible reset before the repeated becoming verb opens that second branch.

topics.headline: either endpoint is enough
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle makes ruin and perishing alternatives, not a required sequence.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the two subjunctive endpoint clauses under the same {{ar:حَتَّى}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) frame.

topics.headline: alternative yet heavier second branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the syntax as disjunction while the semantics rise from pre-death ruin to perishing-class.
topics.reason: The conjunction marks alternatives, while the predicates themselves create a graded terminal pair.

topics.headline: brief reset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a short reset before the repeated becoming verb opens the second branch.
topics.reason: The short conjunction stands directly before the repeated {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}), audibly restarting the formula.

words.prose: The second {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}) repeats the first verb exactly but changes the predicate type. It remains projected under {{ar:حَتَّى}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) and still addresses Jacob, yet with {{ar:مِنَ الْهَالِكِينَ}} ({{tr:mina al-hālikīn}}) it means becoming among a class rather than becoming a bare state. The repetition balances the two branches, while the min-phrase makes the second branch an escalation into category membership; the same shape recalls feared membership language in 12:33.

topics.headline: same addressee, same projection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob remains directly addressed inside the repeated projected becoming frame.
topics.reason: QAC and implicit-argument evidence preserve the same 2ms subject, and the second verb remains under the terminal frame.

topics.headline: becoming among a class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the endpoint shift from an individual ruin-state to membership among the perishing.
topics.reason: The second occurrence takes {{ar:مِنَ الْهَالِكِينَ}} ({{tr:mina al-hālikīn}}) as prepositional predicate, which selects group membership.

topics.headline: parallel form, sharper branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears exact syntactic symmetry while feeling the second predicate intensify the outcome.
topics.reason: The repeated verb creates the bicolon frame, while the bare noun versus min-phrase predicates preserve the escalation.

topics.headline: same-surah membership shape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same-surah pattern of becoming among a group appears here as terminal destruction rather than moral ignorance (12:33).
topics.reason: The 12:33 comparison is a concrete syntactic echo, but the local predicate remains {{ar:الْهَالِكِينَ}} ({{tr:al-hālikīn}}).

words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) is the grammatical hinge of the second endpoint. It governs {{ar:الْهَالِكِينَ}} ({{tr:al-hālikīn}}) and turns the predicate of {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}) into membership: Jacob may become among the perishing, not move spatially from them. This prepositional predicate contrasts with the bare noun {{ar:حَرَضًا}} ({{tr:ḥaraḍan}}), so the syntax itself helps escalate from an individual ruin-state to inclusion in a defined class. As a compact nasal preposition, it binds tightly into the final perishing phrase rather than standing as a separate lexical image.

topics.headline: among, not spatial from
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition assigns Jacob to a class rather than marking spatial source.
topics.reason: The preposition governs a definite plural active participle and supplies the predicate complement of the second {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}).

topics.headline: syntax marks escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second branch differ structurally from the first: bare state becomes class membership.
topics.reason: The first branch uses a bare accusative predicate, while the second branch uses {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) plus a definite plural.

topics.headline: compact class hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the small preposition bind tightly into the final perishing phrase.
topics.reason: The preposition's force is completed only by the following class noun and forms one final predicate unit.

words.prose: {{ar:الْهَالِكِينَ}} ({{tr:al-hālikīn}}) is the semantic core of the final min-phrase: Jacob is projected as one among the defined perishing ones. Its definite plural active-participle form makes the endpoint a recognized class and presents perishing as an ongoing or identifying quality, not simply a completed death report. The h-l-k range brings a destruction register stronger than ordinary illness, while the local Form I participle keeps Jacob as a perisher rather than an explicit object of someone else's destroying. The destruction-root endpoint also resonates with Yusuf's later historical notice in 40:34, with threatened end-state language in 12:32, and with providential perishing in 8:42, while remaining here the brothers' grief-prognosis. As the final word, it completes the move from {{ar:حَرَضًا}} ({{tr:ḥaraḍan}}) to a perishing class and closes the brothers' verdict.

topics.headline: defined class of perishing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word does not just say dead; it places Jacob among a definite active-participle class.
topics.reason: QAC tags the word as a definite masculine plural active participle governed by {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}).

topics.headline: semantic core of membership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the class noun, not the preposition alone, define the final endpoint.
topics.reason: The noun is the governed object of {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) and supplies the predicate content of the second {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}).

topics.headline: doom register, local participle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears Quranic destruction weight in the root while keeping the local form as an intransitive perishing participle.
topics.reason: The root range includes destruction and causative forms, but the local word is an active participle from the perishing side, not a Form IV causative.

topics.headline: last word lands on perishing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing not on memory or grief but on the strongest terminal class.
topics.reason: The word is the ayah's final term and completes the terminal bicolon begun by {{ar:حَرَضًا}} ({{tr:ḥaraḍan}}).

topics.headline: destruction echoes around Yusuf
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destruction-root endpoint resonates with other feared or providential end-state language while remaining the brothers' grief-prognosis here.
topics.reason: The cited echoes give concrete contrasts such as 40:34, 12:32, and 8:42, but they do not change the local min-phrase membership reading.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قالوا تالله تفتؤ تذكر يوسف حتى تكون حرضا أو تكون من الهالكين
baseline_models.mechanism: The collective utterance turns continuous remembrance into an oath-backed causal prognosis with two named terminal states: wasting at the brink and outright destruction.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the collective act that frames the prognosis.
The divine name used in an oath supplies solemn force to the prognosis.
Recall after absence supplies the continuous process that the speakers blame.
Repeated becoming supplies temporal transition into each predicted state.
Melting at the brink of destruction supplies the wasting endpoint.
Falling into destruction and disappearance supplies the terminal alternative.

changed_reading.before: The brothers simply tell the father to stop mentioning Joseph.
changed_reading.after: They solemnize a causal diagnosis: sustained recall will transform his condition into wasting or destruction.

baseline_models.mechanism: Remembrance defeats Joseph's absence by repeatedly restoring him to inward presence, while the speakers construe that same maintenance as dissolving the person who performs it.

activation_trace.role: Heart-held recall supplies Joseph's continued presence despite physical absence.
A reminder that makes something present supplies active maintenance rather than passive feeling.
Dissolution under grief supplies the perceived bodily cost of maintaining presence.

changed_reading.before: Memory is passive attachment to a lost person.
changed_reading.after: Memory is an active presence-maintaining operation whose perceived cost is dissolution of the rememberer.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage speech against speech: the group voices an oath to rebuke the father's recurring voicing of Joseph's name, making remembrance a contest over family discourse as well as an inward state.

activation_trace.role: Overt utterance supplies the brothers' collective counter-speech.
Oath usage intensifies their attempt to close the verbal dispute.
Mention on the tongue supplies the live possibility that Joseph is being repeatedly named aloud.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns only private recollection.
changed_reading.after: It may also expose a struggle over whether Joseph's name may remain audible within the family.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حتى تكون حرضا أو تكون من الهالكين
baseline_models.mechanism: The duplicated becoming and the disjunction separate loss of strength and usefulness from outright destruction, so the utterance classifies two feared outcomes instead of merely piling up synonyms.

activation_trace.role: Two occurrences of realized becoming supply a bifurcated state transition.
Weakness and loss of usefulness supply a social-functional collapse short of death.
Destruction and disappearance supply the distinct final outcome.

changed_reading.before: Wasting and death are interchangeable hyperbole.
changed_reading.after: The speakers distinguish disabled survival from final destruction, sharpening their speech into a two-outcome diagnosis.

baseline_models.mechanism: A branch-level reading hears remembrance as repetitive memorial work: it continually restores its object, persists as an occupation, and expends the worker's effort until the work becomes self-consuming.

activation_trace.role: Repeated re-presentation supplies the ongoing task performed by remembrance.
Continuance and persistence in work supply the labor-like duration latent in the focus root.
Exhausting and spending effort supplies the mechanism by which memorial labor consumes its agent.

changed_reading.before: Grief passively happens to the father.
changed_reading.after: The brothers portray remembering as sustained labor that recreates presence while consuming the laborer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier concealment and negated disclosure create a pressure field around Joseph's name. The focus rebuke can therefore function not only as health advice but as an attempt to regulate a memory whose continued presence may make sealed history resurface.

activation_trace.role: Speech used to impose a ruling supplies pressure on another person's practice.
Reminding that restores presence supplies the return of what the group would leave closed.
Hiding something inwardly supplies the sealed side of the pressure mechanism.
Emergence into visibility, explicitly negated there, supplies the disclosure that remains blocked.

structural_cues: 12:77 places a charge about Joseph beside inward concealment and non-disclosure to the brothers.
12:85 again makes Joseph the object of their collective speech, now by regulating the father's remembering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, blocked disclosure, and a later memory-rebuke; I infer that continued remembering may threaten containment. A live alternative is straightforward concern for the father's health.

changed_reading.before: Concerned relatives warn against excessive grief.
changed_reading.after: Their warning may also police a memory whose continued presence presses against an undisclosed history.

context_deltas.mechanism: The elder brother's covenantal refusal to leave until one of two outcomes mirrors the father's non-cessation until one of two outcomes. Persistence is honored as fidelity in the brother but pathologized as wasting in the father.

activation_trace.role: Continuing recall supplies the father's form of steadfast attachment.
Persistence in an occupation supplies a latent durability inside the brothers' negative label.
A confirmed covenant supplies the legitimating reason for the elder brother's persistence.
Prior neglect and loss supply the failure that persistence is meant to repair.
Non-departure under negation supplies the exact staying-until template that mirrors the focus.

structural_cues: 12:80 has فلن أبرح الأرض حتى ... أو ..., while 12:85 has تفتؤ تذكر يوسف حتى ... أو ....
Both constructions hold a present action open until one of two future resolutions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the grammatical mirror, covenant, and prior neglect; I infer a social asymmetry in how endurance is judged. A live alternative is that the shared idiom marks two genuinely costly forms of persistence without exposing hypocrisy.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an unmarked warning about unhealthy duration.
changed_reading.after: It selectively pathologizes the father's fidelity in the same formal shape that had dignified a son's covenantal staying.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sons bound valid assertion to witnessed knowledge and disclaim custody of the unseen, whereas the father claims knowledge beyond theirs. His remembering can preserve a live possibility across the gap left by their visible-evidence regime.

activation_trace.role: Stable inward recall supplies retention of Joseph across evidentiary absence.
Presence with observation supplies the sons' stated evidentiary boundary.
What is hidden from sight supplies the domain their report excludes.
Guarding and preserving, denied of them there, supplies the custody that memory continues to perform.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the explicit asymmetry between the father's knowledge and theirs.

structural_cues: 12:81 contrasts what the sons witnessed and knew with an unseen realm they did not guard.
12:86 answers their prognosis with أعلم ... ما لا تعلمون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit limits on testimony and a later knowledge contrast; I infer that remembrance preserves an unresolved proposition rather than merely repeating a settled loss. A live alternative is that the father's confidence arises independently of memory.

changed_reading.before: Remembering Joseph repeats a known and closed loss.
changed_reading.after: Remembering Joseph preserves a live counter-claim that the brothers' bounded evidence cannot close.

context_deltas.mechanism: Restraint, withdrawal, bodily whitening, and held silence revise the public-mention baseline. Remembrance persists even when speech is contained, with its pressure registered somatically rather than simply broadcast.

activation_trace.role: Heart-held recall supplies a mode of remembrance that need not be spoken.
Holding the self back from panic supplies deliberate emotional containment.
Turning away supplies social withdrawal rather than repetitive public display.
Whitening supplies the visible bodily registration of contained grief.
Holding breath and remaining silent supplies the blocked verbal outlet.

structural_cues: 12:83 names self-restraint before 12:84 turns away, shows whitened eyes from grief, and closes with contained silence.
The brothers' تذكر in 12:85 follows a scene in which one utterance of sorrow coexists with withdrawal and suppression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, withdrawal, bodily change, and silence; I infer that unspoken recall is converted into somatic pressure. A live alternative is that the body registers grief generally, without a specific causal role for remembrance.

changed_reading.before: تذكر chiefly means that the father continually voices Joseph's name.
changed_reading.after: It can mean persistent inward holding that survives curtailed speech and becomes legible in the body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers direct an oath-laden diagnosis at the father; he answers by directing complaint and the disclosure of stored grief to God while asserting differential knowledge. The issue becomes not whether memory speaks, but where and on what epistemic ground it speaks.

activation_trace.role: Collective utterance supplies the family's diagnostic address.
The divine name in their oath supplies the first speech act's solemn framing.
Voicing a remembered person supplies the disputed expressive act.
Making complaint manifest supplies a deliberate channel for grief.
Revealing what was stored in the self supplies release without indiscriminate broadcast.
Knowledge disclosed to its possessor supplies the father's different basis for speaking.

structural_cues: The collective قالوا تالله is answered by the singular إنما أشكو ... إلى الله.
The answer joins directed complaint to an explicit claim of knowledge unavailable to the speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed addressees, disclosed inner grief, and unequal knowledge; I infer that destination changes remembrance from family-bound rumination into selective complaint. A live alternative is that 12:86 is only a defensive reply and not a transformation of memory.

changed_reading.before: Remembering is repetitive speech trapped inside a family feedback loop.
changed_reading.after: Remembering is rerouted into selective disclosure to God, refusing the sons' prognosis without denying grief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next movement converts retained remembrance into sensory investigation, explicitly blocks severed hope, and opens relief. This reverses the brothers' arrow from memory to death into a live sequence from remembered trace to search.

activation_trace.role: Keeping Joseph present supplies the retained trace that can orient a search.
Near-dissolution supplies the terminal trajectory that the following action interrupts.
Destruction supplies the closed endpoint against which search reopens possibility.
Following reports and traces supplies the practical conversion of memory into investigation.
Severance of hope, twice negated, blocks the brothers' terminal closure.
Relief and rest supply the open alternative toward which search is directed.

structural_cues: 12:85 predicts two terminal outcomes; 12:87 instead issues an imperative to investigate Joseph and repeats a ban on despair.
The remembered name in 12:85 becomes the explicit object of search in 12:87.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate sequence, the same absent person, trace-seeking, and negated despair; I infer that remembrance helps preserve the target of action. A live alternative is that the father's stated knowledge, rather than memory itself, is the sufficient trigger.

changed_reading.before: Persistent remembrance is a closed loop that can only consume life.
changed_reading.after: Persistent remembrance is also an archive of presence that can be converted into search, hope, and possible recovery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same collective oath opening returns when the brothers recognize Joseph and admit that they missed the right. The formula that had certified their prognosis becomes a vehicle of self-correction, retrospectively weakening their authority in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Collective articulated speech supplies the first assertion in the echoed formula.
The divine oath supplies the focus assertion's claimed certainty.
The same collective utterance reopens the formula for confession.
Renewed oath usage formally links confession to the earlier prognosis.
Preference by choice supplies their newly confessed valuation of Joseph.
Missing the right supplies explicit acknowledgment that their prior judgments were unreliable.

structural_cues: The first formula predicts the father's ruin; the second confesses Joseph's preference and the speakers' error.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rare verbal echo and explicit admission of error; I infer that the later oath retrospectively undercuts the earlier diagnosis. A live alternative is that the echo marks intensity without specifically recalling 12:85.

changed_reading.before: The oath formula certifies the truth of the brothers' terminal prognosis.
changed_reading.after: The same formula becomes self-correcting speech, exposing confidence in 12:85 as fallible rather than diagnostic authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus projects a one-way bodily transition toward wasting or destruction, but the packet later routes a material trace of Joseph to the impaired face with a projected return of sight. The body becomes a reversible transmission site rather than a terminal sink.

activation_trace.role: Repeated becoming supplies the one-way forecast that the later counter-transition contests.
Bodily dissolution supplies the predicted direction of change.
Whitening supplies the concrete impairment preceding the terminal prediction.
The seeing organ supplies the bodily site whose state can later change.

Casting and placing supplies the transfer action that delivers the trace.
The face as bodily front supplies the receiving surface.
Ocular seeing supplies the projected restorative endpoint.

structural_cues: 12:84 gives whitened eyes, 12:85 predicts wasting or destruction, and 12:93 routes Joseph's garment to the father's face with projected sight.
The terminal future in the focus is followed by a different bodily future attached to contact with Joseph's trace.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impairment and a material remedial sequence; I infer that the body remains open to reversal rather than merely documenting decline. A live alternative is that Joseph's intervention overrides the prognosis independently of the father's remembering.

changed_reading.before: The body has a one-way trajectory from remembrance to wasting and death.
changed_reading.after: That trajectory is only one projected becoming; a later material relay from Joseph opens a counter-becoming toward sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the washing-plant and alkali branch is far from the ordinary predication of wasting. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and the immediately preceding whitening of the eyes; downstream prose should present it as a material echo of bleaching or corrosion, not as a replacement translation of حرضا.

activation_trace.role: A washing plant and its alkali supply a bleaching or caustic material analogy inside the focus root.
Literal whitening supplies the adjacent visible effect that activates the material analogy.
The eye as seeing organ supplies the specific surface on which the whitening appears.

changed_reading.before: حرضا names only generalized emaciation near death.
changed_reading.after: Alongside that sense, the adjacency permits an alkali-like bleaching echo in which grief visibly whitens and corrodes the eyes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because حرضا grammatically names depletion, while incitement and persistence are branch-distant countercurrents. The reading remains anchored in the same root and gains an enacted direction from the immediate command to trace Joseph and reject despair; downstream prose should call it latent reversal or foreshadowing, not an alternate lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حرضا within the warning against unceasing remembrance

activation_trace.role: Heating and incitement toward action supply a live reversal within the depletion root.
Persistence in work supplies durable exertion beneath the predicted weakness.
Following a report or trace gives the latent exertion a concrete searching direction.
The twice-negated severance of hope prevents the exertion from collapsing into the predicted endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The focus root marks exhausted incapacity only.
changed_reading.after: Its branch cloud also stores heat and persistence, so the warning inadvertently foreshadows remembrance being mobilized into search.

strongest_changes: The mirrored non-cessation-until constructions in 12:80 and 12:85 expose opposed valuations of persistence.
The evidence contrast in 12:81 and 12:86 recasts remembrance as preservation of a live counter-claim.
The search and anti-despair movement in 12:87 reverses the proposed arrow from memory to death.
The repeated قالوا تالله in 12:91 turns the brothers' certainty into confessed fallibility.
The material route from garment to face and sight in 12:93 weakens the one-way bodily prognosis.
summary.what_was_special: The focus generated several coexisting readings through formal echoes and the unusually reversible branch field of ح ر ض: terminal melting, loss of function, sustained labor, incitement, and even an alkali-whitening analogy. Context did not erase the baseline danger reading; it exposed its social selectivity, epistemic contestability, and capacity to reverse into search and recovery.
remaining_uncertainties: تذكر can remain inward, become audible naming, or move between both; the packet supports but does not settle the distribution.
The concealed-history reading identifies a plausible function of the brothers' rebuke, not a demonstrated motive.
The alkali-whitening and incitement readings are branch-driven echoes and should not be rendered as direct denotations.
The later restorative route may overturn the prognosis through Joseph's intervention without making remembrance itself causally restorative.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Unceasing recollection is framed as a wasting process.** ف ت ء B001 (continuing without ceasing under negation), ذ ك ر B003/B004, ح ر ض B003 (wasting to death’s edge), and ه ل ك B001 form the sons’ causal model. I infer that they treat remembrance as consuming bodily viability. The ayah preserves their alarm without endorsing their estimate of hope.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:87 converted supposedly destructive remembrance into active search, and 12:96 verified Jacob’s knowledge by restoring sight.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A prognosis of grief as bodily wasting.** `ح ر ض:B003` is “wasting to the edge of death,” specifically through grief, love, sickness, or similar pressure. The speakers connect unceasing mention to progressive bodily ruin, after 12:84 gives whitened eyes and contained grief; 12:86-90, however, shows complaint, search, encounter, and recognition emerging from the same remembered attachment. The packet supplies their causal forecast and the counter-sequence; I infer that the quoted diagnosis mistakes intensity for terminal incapacity. *Takūna ḥaraḍan* reads as their anxious interpretation, not the only function of remembrance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:96 restores Jacob's sight and immediately overturns the brothers' terminal prognosis; what they read as irreversible bodily wasting becomes a reversible condition inside the reunion sequence.

Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey kaybolma, bozulma, ölüm veya ortadan kalkma sonucunda varlığını ya da işlevini yitirir.
Geçişli kullanımda bir kişi veya güç başka bir şeyi yok oluş ya da ağır bozulma sonucuna sürükler.
Korku, yoksulluk ve ağır eziyet de yol açtıkları yıkım bakımından bu adla anılabilir.
Belirli bir yatak ifadesinde anlam, kişinin yatağın üzerine düşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, varlığın veya işlevin kayıp, bozulma, ölüm ve yoklukla sona ermesidir. Geçişli kullanım bu sonucu başkasına yöneltir; ağır sıkıntı adlandırmaları ve yatağa düşme örneği ise çekirdeğin özel bağlamlardaki uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Varlığın ya da işlevin kayıp, bozulma, ölüm veya ortadan kalkmayla sona erdiği çekirdek durum ile bunun başkasına yaptırıldığı geçişli kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem yok oluş sonucunu hem de bir başkasını bu sonuca sürükleme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin, malın veya düzenin ağır bozulma ve yok oluşa uğradığı bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağır bozulma ve yok oluş sonucunu güçlü biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Sahibinin elinden çıkma gibi daha tarafsız kayıp kullanımlarını ve geçişli yönü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız kişinin yatak veya döşek üzerine düştüğünü bildiren özel kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Özel kullanımın düşme hareketini ve hedef yüzeyi eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kaybolma, bozulma, ölüm ve yokluk gibi birden çok yok oluş biçimini ve özel bağlam uzantılarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yok oluşa düşmenin yanında başkasını oraya düşürme ve başkası için yok edici olma özelliğini daha doğrudan öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir varlığın yok oluşa uğramasını ve bu sonucun başkasına yöneltilebilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yok oluşa düşme ve düşürme ekseninde daha sıkıdır; odak dal ise kayıp, bozulma, ölüm ve bütünüyle ortadan kalkma türlerini daha geniş biçimde bir araya getirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal sahibinin elinden çıkma ve yiyeceğin bozulması gibi özel gerçekleşmeleri de barındırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sapma, bela ve yıkım yeri gibi kendine özgü değerlendirme ve bağlamları da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da kişi veya şeyin bozulması, geçersizleşmesi ve yok olması ortak alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekler güçlü biçimde örtüşse de özel kullanımlar ve değerlendirme alanları aynı değildir; bu yüzden tam eş anlamlılık kurulamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli yapılarda kişinin bir uğurda kendini zorlayıp gücünü tüketmesini ve yolun kendisinden geçeni yormasını bildirir. Bu, başkasını öldürme veya bozma anlamı değil, harcanan gücün tükenme noktasına varmasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, kişinin kendini bir işte tüketmesi ve yolun geçeni tüketmesi yapılarıyla sınırlıdır; yalın köke genel çaba veya yok etme anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapılarda kişinin bir iş uğruna kendisini çok zorlayıp gücünü tüketmesi veya zorlu bir yolun içinden geçeni yorup tüketmesidir.

facets.statement: Kişi bir iş uğruna kendisini çok zorlayarak gücünü tüketir.
Zorlu bir yol, içinden geçen kişinin gücünü tüketip onu bitkin bırakır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal tek bir sözlük tanıklığıyla sınırlıdır; aşağıdaki not kişi ile yol arasında değişen yorulma ilişkisini ve yapıya bağlı anlam sınırını taşır.

source_details.summary: Kişi bir uğurda kendisini zorlayarak gücünü tüketir; özne yol olduğunda ise yol, içinden geçeni bitkin bırakır.

concept_gloss.text: kendini bir uğurda tüketmek veya yolda tükenmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin yoğun çabayla kendi gücünü tükettiği yapı ile yolun yolcuyu tükettiği yapı arasında değişen katılımcı yönünü birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Yoğun çabayı, güç kaybını ve yol ile yolcu arasındaki tüketme ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin bütün gücünü belirli bir işe verip kendisini bitkin düşürdüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kendi çabasıyla gücünü tüketmesini ve iş yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolun uzunluğu veya zorluğuyla içinden geçeni bitkin bıraktığı anlatımlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yolun etkileyen, yolcunun yorulan taraf olduğu ilişkiyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnız belirli yapılarda kişinin kendini veya yolun yolcuyu tüketmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yoğun çaba ve öğüt vermenin yanında toprağı aşırı işleyerek dinlenemez duruma getirmeyi ve içindekini çıkarmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da yoğun uğraş, kişinin ya da bir varlığın gücünü son sınırına kadar harcar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak yapıya bağlı tükenme sonucunu şart koşar; komşu yoğun çabayı daha geniş katılımcılar ve işlemlerle anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal çabanın kişiyi veya yolcuyu tüketip bitkin bırakması sonucunu içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız gayret gösterme ve elinden geleni yapmayı anlatır; tükenme sonucu zorunlu değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişi bir amaç için yoğun çaba ve güç harcar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu gayretin kendisinde durur; odak bu gayretin gücü tüketme derecesine ulaşmasını gerektirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gücü tüketen işi veya yolu ve bu sonuca götüren ilişkiyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nedeninden bağımsız olarak yorgunluk, bitkinlik, güçsüzlük ve başkasını yorma durumlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Odak dalın sonunda kişi yorgun ve güçsüz duruma gelebilir; bu sonuç komşu dalın çekirdeğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu sonuç durumunu genel olarak adlandırır; odak ise belirli bir çaba veya yolun bu sonucu doğurmasına odaklanır.

root_profile.summary: Kökün merkezinde bir şeyin kaybolması, bozulması, ölmesi veya yok edilmesi vardır; buradan ölümcül tehlikeye giriş, tehlikeli yer, kuraklık ve gücü tüketen çaba gibi sonuç ve benzerlik temelli alanlar gelişir. Salınarak yürüme, yoksul yardım arayıcıları, tarihsel meslek nitelemesi, değişmez söyleyişler, yönsüz dolaşma, asılsızlığa saplanma, doymak bilmez istek ve aile ilişkili iki yönlü kullanım ise belirgin biçimde özelleşmiş kollardır.
